Several trees and houses were damaged in the municipality of Tiwi, Albay while those in Malinao remain submerged in flood on Monday due to #RollyPH.

Even before #RollyPH made its first landfall, VP Leni Robredo had already begun distributing food packs to areas forecast to be in the trajectory of the super typhoon. These food packs were delivered to Calabanga and Magarao, in Camarines Sur, both coastal and flood prone areas. Also, before the sun rose this morning, VP Leni already boarded a plane to CamSur, and eventually visited our kababayans at Albay and Catanduanes, too.

In her office, donations for those affected by #RollyPH in different provinces continue to pour in right up to this very minute, understandably because the Vice President is the most trusted official in our country. 

#MaramingSalamat #VPLeni for your tireless dedication to us and Pilipinas. ❤️

(Thank you, Ariel Endaya for the image below).
